domains.name: Verbal Skills (Vocabulary, Analogies, Antonyms, Logic, Verbal Classification)
Quantitative Skills (Number Series, Geometric Comparison, Non-Verbal Reasoning)
Language Skills (Punctuation, Capitalization, Usage, Spelling, Composition)

exam_format: Paper-based; five required sections plus optional Religion and Mechanical Aptitude; no penalty for wrong answers
exam_price_notes: ~$25-50, paid through the school administering the test. No centralized registration — apply directly to each high school.

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-15: STS's HSPT parent page is live ('For over fifty years, academic high schools nationwide have used STS' High School Placement Test (HSPT) ... a comprehensive placement test for eighth graders').

prerequisites.description: 8th graders applying to participating Catholic and private high schools; registration through individual schools
